scope: Exact MXFP4 weight reconstruction and fp8 e4m3fn per-row-scaled weight decoding to BF16; caller-owned buffers and HIP stream; no allocation or synchronization
arithmetic: OCP E2M1/G32/E8M0 to BF16; preserves signed zero, edge scales and reference rounding
graph_contract: Fixed shapes; caller-owned buffers and stream; initialize before capture; changed inputs supported
abi: paiton_mxfp4_unpack(uint8*, uint8*, bf16*, size_t, hipStream_t) -> int; paiton_fp8row_unpack(uint8*, float*, bf16*, int rows, int cols, hipStream_t) -> int
